thread:
anya: FYI the stratus11b-int4 canary is throwing intermittent OOMs when requests hit >600 tokens. Seen on 3 nodes in the canary pool.
devin: can you paste the error log/snippet? which route / model config?
anya: stack trace attached below, short snippet: 
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating KV cache (requested 1.3GB)
node=canary-ml-07 | pid=3241 | rss=78G | gpu0=14.2G/24G
route: /generate/stratus11b-int4
model_config: quant=int4, prefetch=true, max_new_tokens_default=1024, batch_size=8
```
jia: oof, that max_new_tokens_default is the big signal. In int4 the kv cache per token is denser due to tile packing — long generations blow past reservation. Immediate mitigation: drop default to 256 and enforce per-route hard cap of 512. Also set prefetch=false for the canary to reduce transient allocs.
kevin: agreed. Also seeing memory fragmentation from repeated small allocations — we should enable slot_compactor on the canary and run a one-off kv_prune cycle (evict older sessions >30m). Suggest config patch: 
```
model_runtime:
  max_new_tokens_default: 256
  max_new_tokens_hard_limit: 512
  prefetch: false
  batch_size: 4
  kv_prune:
    enable: true
    min_age_seconds: 1800
  slot_compactor:
    enabled: true
    cadence: 10m
    threshold: 0.6
```
sara: timeline? If we push that patch canary->smoke tests->observe for 1 hour? If stable we roll to 20% traffic. If not, rollback.
anya: I'll patch the canary now with those values and disable prefetch. Monitoring hooks: token-level mem, per-gpu headroom, and OOM-rate.
devin: add a temporary circuit-breaker: reject requests with client max_tokens > 512 with 429 and a clear message. We had a customer call last week that triggered similar.
anya: added short rule in the ingress filter: `if request.max_tokens > 512 -> 429` — deploying.
(1 min later) deploy-bot: canary deployment "stratus11b-int4-cfg-20260321-1" updated: prefetch=false, max_new_tokens_default=256, batch_size=4
jeff: (reacts :thumbsup:)
kevin: after the patch I also kicked off a compaction run on the 3 affected nodes. Will post commands I ran: `runtask compactor --pool canary-ml --target=nodes:canary-ml-{05..08}`
jia: let's also add a post-mortem checklist item: evaluate per-token kv size for int4 vs int8 on stratus11b and consider a smaller prefix cache for long-form routes.
sara: sounds good. if after 1h no OOMs we promote to 20% and monitor for 24h before full rollout.
anya: initial 30m looks stable on the canary (0 OOMs, memory headroom improved ~3.2GB). Will keep watching and run small regen quality checks to ensure no perf regression from batch_size=4.
devin: great. if anything spikes ping me and i'll pause rollout.
anya: thanks all, plan: monitor 24h, then schedule gradual ramp with canary autoscale off.
sara: noted, i'll update the rollout doc.
anya: closing the thread if stable after 24h — will post follow-up results.
